name: SESSION_KEY
description: Hash of one session (auth-design 0.2); TTL is the refresh TTL.

name: USER_SESSIONS_KEY
description: Set of the sids of one user; TTL is the refresh TTL, reset when a sid is added.

name: SESSION_FIELD_USER_ID
description: Id of the user who owns the session.

name: SESSION_FIELD_METHOD
description: How the user logged in: password (later google, oidc).

name: SESSION_FIELD_DEVICE_ID
description: Device id sent by the client; empty for now.

name: SESSION_FIELD_PLATFORM
description: web with X-Client: web, else other.

name: SESSION_FIELD_REFRESH_HASH
description: sha256 of the current refresh token.

name: SESSION_FIELD_PREV_REFRESH_HASH
description: sha256 of the refresh token before the last rotation; empty until one.

name: SESSION_FIELD_ROTATED_AT
description: Time of the last rotation; empty until one.

name: SESSION_FIELD_CLAIMS_VERSION
description: Starts at 1; an access token with a lower cv is stale.

name: SESSION_FIELD_REVOKED
description: 1 when the session is revoked, else 0.

name: SESSION_FIELD_REVOKED_REASON
description: Why the session was revoked; empty while active.
